create_crossvit_classifier: create a CrossViT model for image classification with multi-scale patch encoding and cross-attention
build_image_embedder: build an ImageEmbedder that converts images into patch tokens with CLS token and positional embeddings
build_multi_scale_encoder: build a MultiScaleEncoder with separate small and large patch transformers and cross-attention layers
build_cross_transformer: build a CrossTransformer that performs bidirectional cross-attention between small and large patch tokens
build_attention_module: build an Attention module with query/key/value projections and cross-attention support via context input
